name: 苏小满
revision_direction: 轻柔、舒缓、有耐心的16岁少女声；柔软起音、轻盈共鸣、少量自然气息，音量克制，语速稍缓，句尾轻收。情绪平和、像在近处安慰熟悉的朋友；减少强调、尖亮感与上扬，保留自然清晰的英语发音。用户已确认先使用当前音色，作为后续配音参考。
note: 用户确认先使用当前轻柔、舒缓、有耐心的少女声，作为苏小满后续配音参考。

history.user_feedback: 苏小满是一个什么样的性格，我感觉这个声音不是很好听
history.original_instruction: A 16-year-old female high-school student with a light, clear, fresh mid-high teenage voice. She is observant, sincere, practical and quietly determined. Her phrasing is direct and well organized, with warmth and a little dry amusement. She speaks as an equal to her classmates, with a youthful lightly textured voice, natural contractions and small pauses. No mature professional presenter sound, baby talk or exaggerated cuteness.

A 16-year-old female high-school student talking warmly with a close classmate. A youthful, clear, smooth and gently rounded teenage female voice in a comfortable middle-to-upper register, with a soft luminous tone and light natural resonance. Friendly, thoughtful, attentive and quietly cheerful, with a small genuine smile in her voice. Her speech flows easily, with natural contractions, relaxed sentence openings and small expressive changes of pitch. When admitting she gets nervous, let a little honest shyness show; when sharing her own idea, she is gently assured. Keep the phrasing personal and conversational, like a real schoolgirl talking nearby. Favor a smooth clear tone with little nasal edge, little vocal fry and only a light trace of air. Avoid shrill brightness, a clipped commanding delivery, an adult teacher or presenter sound, whispering, baby talk and exaggerated sugary cuteness.
